svg.title: How the assistant chooses the language of a comment
svg.desc: The AI answers in the reporter's language and names its code. A code of a catalog in locales/, such as fr, gives the assistant's own words and days from that catalog; other, for a language without a catalog, gives English words around the AI's text and days in ISO 8601. The hidden marker of the comment keeps the code. A comment without AI, such as a reminder, a closing or the note of a release, takes the code from the marker of the last analysis or follow-up; without one, from the reporter's own words, the language whose stopwords they use most, English on a tie.
